answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the quartz check immediately, the pearl audit keeps the resolved set and the voyage replay makes public exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 32 aliases therefore forfeits the reading cost 32 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
